scripts.redis:preflight: if [ -f ./src/config/redis-preflight.js ]; then node ./src/config/redis-preflight.js; else node -r ts-node/register ./src/config/redis-preflight.ts; fi
scripts.configure:commerce: medusa exec "$(if [ -f ./src/scripts/configure-commerce.js ]; then echo ./src/scripts/configure-commerce.js; else echo ./src/scripts/configure-commerce.ts; fi)"
scripts.seed:product: medusa exec "$(if [ -f ./src/scripts/seed-product.js ]; then echo ./src/scripts/seed-product.js; else echo ./src/scripts/seed-product.ts; fi)"
scripts.predeploy: npm run redis:preflight && medusa db:migrate --execute-safe-links && npm run configure:commerce && npm run seed:product
